title: X-Caret System - P. Beddows 2003 (dye-trace sketch)
credits: X-Caret System, X'Caret, Quintana Roo: sketch map of the dye-tracing test (injection site, sampling points A, B, C; Injection Site - A = 90 m, A - B = 210 m, A - C = 310 m), in P. A. Beddows, Cave Hydrogeology of the Caribbean Yucatan Coast (PhD thesis, University of Bristol, 2003), p. 46
placementWhy: Free similarity fit on nine ground points, none a cenote with a known position (Mapbox satellite and Mapbox Streets' OSM data; Overpass timed out): the walled square at the road's west end on the Plaza Principal courtyard building (6.8 m); B, at the narrow neck of the caleta's stippled north arm, on the north end of the caleta channel's open water (16.8 m); the west tip of the U-shaped arm on the west tip of the heart-shaped lagoon (6.6 m); and six points along the curved rocky tongue of land that closes the heart-shaped lagoon from the south-east, drawn on the map as the white tongue between the U-shaped arm and the sea's shore stipple - its tip (10.7 m), its sea shore east (5.9 m), south-east bend (11.0 m) and south (15.1 m), its lagoon shore south (1.4 m) and near the tip (10.9 m). Fit: 0.948 m/px, rotated 0.6 deg. Checks: the small walled square south of the big one lands 3 m from the Juego de pelota building; the point between the caleta's mouth and the north shore band is 42 m off (the sketch draws that wedge of land loosely; it was a fit point before the tongue was used); the north arm's lobes reach 31 m short of the north end of the creek continuing the caleta under the trees. The road east from the square follows the park's walkway east of Plaza Principal. At this scale the drawn routes measure roughly Injection Site - A 104 m (the map says 90 m), A - B 182 m (210 m), A - C 300 m (310 m). The south-west pool lands among the park's buildings near the coast, where no open water shows today. Compared with the unverified 1979 Cueva de Xcaret map (xcaret-1979.json), placed on the same caleta: this map's A lies some 60-80 m south-west of its cenote de Felipe, and this map's passage by the black building (the 1979 map's Mayan ruins by cenote de los franceses) some 50-70 m north of cenote de los franceses; both are guesses on park landmarks and nothing is taken from the 1979 map's positions. Reviewed on the satellite by the user (2026-10-02) and accepted: no longer unverified (it was: No cenote of the map has a position in the database (the Xcaret sistema's only cave has neither name nor coordinates), and the map is a schematic sketch with no scale bar or north arrow. Placed only by ground features on the satellite - the Plaza Principal building, the caleta channel, the heart-sha).

trace.why: Not a stick map: each passage is drawn as a narrow double line (its two walls); the ponds, the pools, the caleta and the sea's shore as stippled water along a shore line. The passages are the drawn walls closed into one band (inkBand: closed 7 px, so each passage keeps its width; no colour fill on this black-and-white sketch - threshold 255). The stippled areas and the dashed passage, whose dots and dashes are too short for the ink band, are added as fillPolygons, made from the ink of each area (the south-west pool, the C ponds, the dashed passage, the caleta's north arm with B and the island west of B, its channel, the U-shaped west arm, and the stippled shore of the sea north-east of the mouth, along the tongue of land and to the south-west) closed 11 px so the dots merge, outer outline taken 2 px in. The walls are the band's outline only where the map draws ink (wallsOnInk: none across the caleta's mouth to the open sea, nor along a label's cut). Everything drawn inside - the stipple, the islands, the maze of lines at C - is kept as detail (detailInk), and the black building and the hatched Mayan wall V beside the caleta too (detailAreas; the V's apex is cut so it isn't read as a passage). Water fill only in the caleta's surface water (north arm with B, the island west of B, the channel and the U-shaped west arm, the heart-shaped lagoon) through waterPolygons; the cave passages, the ponds, the pools and the shore stipple stay unfilled. The open sea (white on the map) and the labels are left out; the road, walled squares and the ruins and buildings away from the caleta stay boxed out.

detailAreas.why: the black building and the hatched (Mayan) wall V between the passage and the caleta, drawn as detail

symbols.why: No depths, heights, letter codes, flow arrows, 'To ...' pointers or bones on this sketch (only the sampling letters A, B, C, the Injection Site and the distances box, which are kept as entrances / in the credits).
